card.name: Linking words in hypersensitivity reaction lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas such as "including", "such as", "," and "and" right after "Hypersensitivity Reactions" or inside a list of allergic reactions like anaphylaxis, angioedema, urticaria. Mostly in warnings and precautions sections.

modes.label: Heading link word
modes.description: "including" or "Including" right after the heading Hypersensitivity Reactions, before Anaphylaxis.
modes.example: 5.3 Hypersensitivity Reactions<< including>> Anaphylaxis Hypersensitivity reactions

modes.label: Comma or and in reaction lists
modes.description: A comma, "and" or "as" inside a list of allergic reaction names.

card.plain: It fires on the small connecting words that lead into a list of allergic reactions in a warnings section.
